worldcombat.skill.dreameater.summary: Only usable while the target sleeps: pull its dream out of its head as a thread of smoke and drink it, healing yourself for a share of the damage dealt. The deeper the dream, the bigger the mouthful.
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.use.0: Draw life back into yourself while the foe sleeps
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.use.1: Cash a sleep window opened by a team mate
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.use.2: Reach a sleeper from a distance instead of closing in
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.description: Draws about %1$s Psychic special damage from the sleeper and heals the user for %2$s of the damage actually dealt; the deeper the remaining sleep, the heavier the draw and the higher the share.
Draws from sleepers up to %1$s blocks away, as long as the line to them is clear.
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.deep.on: Deep dive: healing share x1.3, but power x0.85 and a longer wind-up and cooldown - the sustain choice.
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.deep.off: Shallow taste: power x1.12, healing x0.9 and a faster cast - the burst choice.
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.timing: Cast on a sleeping enemy within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP; recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.growth.0: From level %1$s the dream power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.growth.1: From level %1$s the dream power rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s and the draw reach to %4$s blocks.
On: healing share x1.3, but power x0.85, wind-up +4 and cooldown +4 - good for sustain. Off: power x1.12, healing x0.9 and a faster cast - good for burst.
Only reaches for a sleeping target inside this distance; larger opens from further away.
Below this health ratio the user prefers dream eater as sustain; higher leans on it for healing sooner.
world_combat.move.dreameater.text.fade: The dream slipped out of reach
worldcombat.skill.dreameater.description: The target must be asleep; dealing damage wakes it, so a single sleep window usually feeds only one draw.
